name: The Shops of Bella Terra
summary: Sprawling strip mall with a selection of big-box retailers, specialty stores & casual eateries. Conveniently located at Grand Parkway and Bellaire Boulevard in Richmond, serving the western Houston suburbs with accessible open-air shopping.
demographics: The Shops of Bella Terra serves the affluent western Houston suburbs, particularly the Richmond and Katy areas, attracting middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes typically ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The primary trade area includes young professionals, growing families with children, and established homeowners in the rapidly developing Grand Parkway corridor. Shoppers are drawn to the convenience of big-box retailers and specialty stores for everyday needs and family-oriented shopping trips, with a preference for one-stop shopping experiences that combine retail, dining, and services in an accessible open-air format.
description: The Shops of Bella Terra is a sprawling strip mall strategically positioned at the northwest corner of Grand Parkway (Highway 99) and Bellaire Boulevard in Richmond, Texas. This open-air shopping destination serves the rapidly growing western Houston metropolitan area, offering convenient access just south of the Westpark Tollway. The center features a diverse mix of big-box retailers, specialty stores, and casual eateries that cater to the everyday needs of local families and professionals. Managed by FRP Ltd., a real estate investment and development company, Bella Terra has established itself as a community hub in the Grand Parkway corridor, one of Houston's most dynamic growth areas. With ample parking and easy highway access, the shopping center provides a practical and accessible retail experience for residents throughout the Richmond, Katy, and greater Fort Bend County region.
